claim_reviews.conclusion: Valid Malaysian Malay phrase meaning misunderstanding or mistaken understanding.
claim_reviews.subject: Malaysian Malay “salah faham”

claim_reviews.conclusion: “Failure to understand someone or something correctly” is accurate for both forms.

claim_reviews.conclusion: Needs correction: the distinction is not reliably between different national common words, because Indonesian also uses “salah paham”; “kesalahpahaman” is a derived noun and “salah faham” is the Malay spelling/form.

response.rationale: Both translations and the sense are valid, but “different-common-word” overstates the contrast: Indonesian also commonly uses “salah paham,” while “kesalahpahaman” is the derived noun. Malaysian “salah faham” is the corresponding Malay phrase. No false-friend contrast is supported or needed.
